articles.title: Renovation of the Mountain House AC. / DARP - De Arquitectura y Paisaje
english: The renovation of the Mountain House in Retiro, Colombia, completed in 2025, showcases a modern approach to prefabricated wooden structures. This project reflects the possibilities of transforming a home that has stood for over twenty years, emphasizing sustainability and adaptation.

Designed by DARP - De Arquitectura y Paisaje, the renovation not only revitalizes the existing structure but also integrates the surrounding landscape. This holistic approach ensures that the house complements its environment while improving functionality and aesthetic appeal.

Through careful planning and design, the renovation preserves the essence of the original house while introducing modern amenities. This balance of old and new illustrates the evolving nature of architecture in relation to its context.
chinese: 在2025年，哥倫比亞Retiro的山屋改建展示了一種現代化的預製木結構方法。這個項目反映了轉變一座已經存在超過二十年的家的可能性，強調可持續性和適應性。
該改建項目由DARP - De Arquitectura y Paisaje設計，該改建不僅使現有的結構煥然一新，還與周圍的景觀相融合。這種整體方法確保了房屋在提升功能性和美感的同時，能夠與環境相輔相成。
通過精心的規劃與設計，這次改建保留了原始房屋的精髓，同時引入了現代化的設施。這種舊與新的平衡展示了建築隨其環境變化而不斷演變的特性。

articles.topic: Performative Architecture of the White House
articles.title: Dropcity exhibition explores the "performative architecture" of the White House
english: Students at Politecnico di Milano have designed an exhibition titled 'The White House: Domestic Propaganda' at Dropcity, focusing on the White House's political symbolism through its interior. The exhibition features models, furniture references, visual archives, and diagrams that depict the White House as both a home and a powerful political tool.

The exhibition includes seven installations that highlight various domestic elements, from spaces used by service staff to gifts received by presidents. Each installation creatively reinterprets these aspects, showcasing the White House not just as a residence, but as a unique representation of societal ideals.

Curated by students under the guidance of Davide Fabio Colaci and Lola Ottolini, the exhibition invites viewers to reconsider the architectural identity of the White House, reflecting on its role in media democracy and intimacy within politics.
chinese: 米蘭理工大學的學生在Dropcity設計中心策劃了一個名為「白宮：家庭宣傳」的展覽，重點關注白宮的政治象徵及其室內設計。該展覽展示了模型、家具參考、視覺檔案和圖表，將白宮描繪成既是一個家也是一個強大的政治工具。
該展覽包括七個安裝，突出了各種家庭元素，從服務人員使用的空間到總統所收到的禮物。每個安裝創意性地重新詮釋這些方面，展示白宮不僅是一處居所，更是社會理想的獨特表現。
展覽由Davide Fabio Colaci和Lola Ottolini指導的學生策劃，邀請觀眾重新思考白宮的建築身份，反映其在媒體民主和政治親密關係中的角色。

articles.title: clustered domes dot this landscaped rooftop park atop reworked warehouses
english: The Yongping Warehouse in China's Nanhai District has undergone a remarkable transformation by Atelier cnS, turning a line of riverfront industrial buildings into a vibrant landscaped rooftop park. This renovation reflects a shift from utilitarian spaces to those encouraging community engagement, making the waterfront accessible and inviting to residents.

A prominent feature of the design is a series of translucent domed canopies that define the rooftop's silhouette. These canopies not only provide shelter but also create an inviting atmosphere that encourages movement and interaction among visitors, contributing to the overall identity of the space along the river.

Inside, the original masonry facades have been preserved while new elements like concrete and steel introduce a modern touch. The landscape of the rooftop includes grassy slopes and play areas, fostering diverse uses and interactions, thus enriching the experience of the public space.
chinese: 位於中國南海區的永平倉庫經過 Atelier cnS 的改造，將一排河濱工業建築轉變為生機勃勃的綠化屋頂公園。這次翻新反映了實用空間向鼓勵社區互動空間的轉變，讓水邊對居民變得可及且友好。
設計的一個顯著特徵是塑造屋頂輪廓的一系列半透明圓頂篷。這些篷不僅提供庇護，還創造了一種吸引人的氛圍，鼓勵遊客之間的活動與互動，並為沿河地帶的整體身份增添了價值。
室內保留了原有的磚砌外立面，同時新元素如混凝土和鋼材則帶來現代感。屋頂的景觀包括草坡和遊戲區，促進多元使用和互動，從而豐富了這個公共空間的體驗。
